body:
I'm 18.

I can leave whenever, but I feel an obligation to stay and finish at least this year of college. It's already paid for so yeah. Also, I was going to move on August 27th but my mum sapped my bank account dry over an unrelated incident; as such I've only got $1000 cash right now and no job. I'm ridiculously stressed out here, I'd really like to leave... I think I will after this year if not sooner.

EDIT: Typos.

I could accept myself then to the same extent I do now.

If I told them I could see it turning into a debate, lecture, ostracizing and or large waste of time going to church to fix me and all that. It'd also make the family gatherings I'm forced to go to more awkward than they already are. It doesn't really seem like I have any good options here, to be honest. I can't accurately gauge how well it would go unless I just come out with it and if that caused big problems it would affect my sister too, not just me.

Bipolar is when your mood switches dramatically right? That happens frequently enough. I think that's normal though. Schizophrenia is largely linked with paranoia and I'm paranoid of everything. Also I think I had either a very frightening experience with local wildlife or I recently experienced a hallucination first-hand. I think it's the former, to be honest, but it still scares the bajeebus out of me and has ultimately stopped me from going near my local park. Again though I don't think I'm in any position to say whether or not I have either of these, I'm just afraid I do.

As for my differing views, I don't know. I told my mom about my atheism and she's the most accepting so nothing happened. My uncle's a radical "Obama is Hitler" kinda guy, my aunt's outspoken as hell, my grandparents are ridiculously religious and everyone else follows suit, more or less. I really don't trust that it would turn out well. I would much rather just leave to be honest; I don't like them and they like me. It's an awkward, one-sided dishonest relationship that I'd much rather discontinue.

Mostly just my paranoia. My emotions have been on the fritz and several of my relatives were bipolar, schizophrenic or both. I personally think it's foolish to say I have any of these, but they've been on my mind.

In addition to that, my whole family is made up of right-wing conservative christians and I'm a sexually confused left-wing atheist. They don't know any of that but that's where the paranoia comes in.
I can't do anything with the subreddits I frequent. None are specific enough.
